turns.question: What was the week-over-week growth in leads for the week starting 14 September 2026?
turns.answer: Leads grew 20.7% week over week for the week starting 14 September 2026, covering 14 to 20 September 2026 against the week before (a growth value of 0.207, where 0.10 means 10% more). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
